title: Knit status --json
description: What `knit status --json` prints: the resolved bundle and the git state of each of its repos. Read offline; `knit status` never calls the code host. Fields may be added over time, so ignore what you do not know.

resolvedFrom.description: How the bundle was resolved: `explicit` (--bundle), `env` (KNIT_BUNDLE), `cwd` (run inside its worktree) or `workspace` (the workspace fallback).

reviews.description: Review objects (PRs/MRs) recorded for this bundle.

readiness.description: From the recorded reviews only; absent when no review is recorded.

freshForSeconds.description: How long a recorded review reading counts as current; present with `readiness`.

revertVerified.description: Present once a landing merged revert reviews: whether each revert was proven the exact inverse of the change it undoes.

branch.description: The branch the checkout is on (`(detached)` for a detached HEAD); null when there is no checkout.

expectedBranch.description: The bundle's feature branch; null before it is created.

worktree.description: The checkout path, relative to the workspace when inside it.

status.description: The git state of the checkout, or the missing-checkout reason.

wrongBranch.description: True when an in-place checkout sits on a branch other than the bundle's.

unrecorded.description: A short note when commits were made outside Knit that the ledger has not recorded yet.

behind.description: A short note when the checkout has not caught up with the head the ledger records; it names the command that brings it in.

review.description: The repo's review as Knit last recorded it.

mergeable.description: Null once the review is merged or closed.

verdict.description: `ready` or the open gates' headline; null when unknown.

recordedAt.description: When the recorded gates last changed (RFC 3339).
